## What this pull request does

## Checklist
- [ ] One topic only; linked issue: #
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`tests/test_editor`, `test_mattoncini`, `test_motore`, `test_collaudo`)
- [ ] New or updated tests for the change
- [ ] No existing feature removed or broken
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] New third-party resources (if any) have a compatible licence and are listed in `CREDITS.md`
- [ ] Credits and copyright notices kept
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
